description: This is a shell script for managing the sstate cache within a build environment, providing functionalities such as removing duplicate cache files, cleaning up based on stamps directories, and handling various options for selectively removing cache files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information for script options.

methods.name: read_confirm
methods.description: Reads user confirmation input for deletion operations.

methods.name: gen_rmlist
methods.description: Generates a list of files to remove, including handling symlinks and associated metadata files.

methods.name: remove_duplicated
methods.description: Removes duplicate sstate cache files, keeping only the newest per package.

methods.name: rm_by_stamps
methods.description: Removes cache files not used by specified stamps directories.
